source: Current frontend; real FastAPI and isolated PostgreSQL. Search segment uses clearly labeled demo API responses.

chapters.text: LeadFlow | Leads, conversations, and follow-ups in one workspace
Demo sign-in | A browser-tab session, with no password
Pipeline overview | Latest notes, statuses, and activity times
Follow-ups | Today's reminders are pinned; overdue reminders are red
Create a lead | Name required; company and phone are optional
New leads start at New | Open the lead to build its history
Update status | Qualify the lead directly from its dialog
Log a discussion | Keep the conversation and next action together
Schedule follow-up | Save the discussion with a 4:30 PM reminder
Saved immediately | The note appears first and the reminder updates
Today's priorities | The new follow-up is pinned in the lead list
Reload | The discussion, reminder, and status persist in PostgreSQL
Filter the pipeline | Focus on qualified leads
Search UI demo | Fixed demo responses; this segment does not verify Solr
Search UI demo | Find a historical discussion despite a typo
Discussion timeline | All conversations appear newest first
Light mode | A smooth theme change across the entire workspace
